payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to develop per-triple templates, including transforming triples into facts using hand-crafted templates and the implementation of a pipeline for processing these transformations.

claims.text: Per-triple templates were developed using hand-crafted templates for each predicate to transform triples into facts.
The transformation of triples into facts serves to prepare data for subsequent operations and introduce domain knowledge about predicates.
The implementation of the pipeline for template transformations includes using simple templates and neural models.
